correctness.rationale: The exact Fourier product has zeros only at half-integer phases of fair factors; all possible difference valuations lie in r dyadic shells. A 2-branch valuation-partition induction bounds any orthogonal family by 2^r. The binary canonical frequency cube of size 2^r attains equality by explicit odd-integer phase checking. Additional factor support enlarges cardinality, proving the full-basis consequence. A standalone rational-checker exhaustively verified 816 masks, but finite checks are not substituted for the proof.
